meta_title: Mr Decor Midlands | Painter & Decorator Leicester
meta_description: Mr Decor Midlands is Leicester's trusted painter and decorator. Interior and exterior work, free estimates, reliable local service. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Local, Reliable, Fully Insured — Interior & Exterior
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. Free quotes, no hidden charges, work you can trust.
services_subhead: From full interior redecorations to exterior refresh, we handle residential and commercial projects with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Transform living spaces with expert interior painting. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality finishes, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work that protects and enhances your property. Fascias, soffits, doors, and garden walls finished to last.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Precision wallpapering on feature walls or whole rooms. Modern and traditional patterns expertly hung with straight seams and perfect finish.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, and hospitality venues need fast turnaround and minimal disruption. We schedule work around your business hours.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, architraves, doors, and fitted furniture painted and varnished to showcase the natural grain or a flawless colour coat.

services.title: Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Proper surface prep is everything. We repair cracks, sand, prime, and fill so your new finish looks professional and lasts longer.

about_pullquote: We do the job right the first time, because we work for our neighbours.
about_para_1: Mr Decor Midlands has been serving Leicester and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. We started with a simple mission: deliver honest, professional decorating work at fair prices. Today, we've completed over 2,000 residential and commercial projects, built on repeat business and word-of-mouth recommendation.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we show up on time, explain the work clearly, and leave sites clean and tidy. We don't rush jobs to chase the next quote — every project gets the prep and finish it deserves. That's why so many Leicester homeowners and business owners come back to us, year after year.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the living room and hallway redecorated. The lads turned up on time, got the job done to a high standard, and cleaned up after themselves properly. No fuss, no mess. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: We've used Mr Decor for three jobs now — kitchen, bedroom, and exterior fascias. Always reliable, gives honest quotes, and the finish is excellent. Paul and the team know exactly what they're doing.
reviews.author: Margaret W.

reviews.text: Our office needed a complete redecorate in tight timeframe. They scheduled it perfectly around our hours, finished on time, and it looks fantastic. Professional crew, fair pricing, will be back.
reviews.author: James K.
